description: Reads a Zarr array store and returns its values as a table.
comment: Supports local paths and object-store URLs. Use named parameters such as dims and array_path to select a dimension group or nested array.

description: Lists the dimension groups available in a Zarr store.
comment: Use this to discover valid dims values before scanning multi-group datasets.

description: Returns array metadata for a Zarr store, including names, dimensions, shapes, and data types.
comment: Use this to inspect a dataset and choose the array_path for nested stores such as OME-Zarr images.
example: SELECT name, dims, shape, dtype FROM read_zarr_metadata('image.ome.zarr');
